nodes.condition: buff to itself (Grow, Molt gain, Veteran, Coppicer)

nodes.condition: two different mechanics at the same moment
nodes.shows: one at a time, the second at the first's landing + 6

nodes.shows: first full (18 f), each later gap ×0.75, floor 5 f; from the 9th the rest land together; one re-popping running-total burst per card; count held 16 f (a ×N counter needs art)

nodes.condition: bookkeeping that changes a number, pip, pill or plate
